title: MapLayer
description: A universal georeferenced map layer that can be raster (e.g. a GeoTIFF: Soil Organic Matter, NDVI, elevation) OR vector (points, lines, polygons, or many features). Carries the layer type, acquisition time, CRS, bounds, per-layer statistics and optional rendering style, and references the underlying file blob (fileRef → a File/MediaAsset) — vector layers may instead inline small GeoJSON in `features`. Kept generic (not field-specific): the subject it describes is linked via `subjectRef`/`subjectExternalId`. The `dataType` discriminator drives which fields are required.

id.description: Body id (mirrors the metaEnvelope id on the canonical)

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this record's own shape

recordedAt.description: When this record was written, as distinct from when the layer was acquired

supersedes.description: w3ds:// reference to the layer this one replaces

deleted.description: Soft-delete marker; the envelope itself stays, because W3DS has no delete

name.description: Layer name as the person typed it

geometryType.description: For vector layers: the geometry kind (or 'collection' for mixed / many features).

layerType.description: What the layer represents, e.g. { name: 'Soil Organic Matter', dataType: 'raster' }.

id.description: Stable id of the layer type in the producing catalogue, when it has one

name.description: What the layer represents, e.g. Soil Organic Matter

dataType.description: Whether this layer type is normally delivered as a raster grid or as vector features

subjectRef.description: w3ds:// reference to what this layer describes (a LogicalField, parcel, region, asset, …). Generic on purpose.

subjectExternalId.description: The producing service's own subject id, when there is no w3ds subject ref.

acquiredAt.description: When the layer was captured or computed; for a period, its start

acquiredAtEnd.description: End of the acquisition period, when the layer covers a span rather than an instant

fileRef.description: w3ds:// reference to the layer's file blob — a GeoTIFF/COG for raster, or GeoJSON/GeoPackage/FlatGeobuf for large vector.

features.description: Inline GeoJSON for small vector layers (a Geometry, Feature, or FeatureCollection). Large vector data should use fileRef instead.

featureCount.description: For vector layers: how many features the layer holds

previewRef.description: Optional w3ds:// reference to a rendered preview (e.g. a coloured PNG).

bbox.description: Bounds in the layer CRS: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY].

bbox4326.description: Convenience WGS84 bounds [west, south, east, north] for map overlay.

unit.description: Unit the layer's values are expressed in, e.g. % or mg/kg

statistics.description: Per-layer summary (raster pixel stats or vector attribute stats).

count.description: Number of pixels or features the summary is over

LCL_95.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for the mean

UCL_95.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for the mean

style.description: Optional rendering hints — raster: { ramp, min, max }; vector: { stroke, fill, weight, radius }.

min.description: Raster: value mapped to the low end of the ramp

max.description: Raster: value mapped to the high end of the ramp

integrity.description: Checksum of the layer file, so a reader can tell the bytes have not changed

subjectVersion.description: Which version of the subject this layer describes, when the subject is versioned

createdAt.description: When the layer record was saved

createdBy.description: eName of the person who saved the layer
